goal: Create a high-end, very legible UI component design proposal for DreamFlutter, a literary desktop AI assistant. This is a concept sheet, not a screenshot of a finished product. Explore how antique artifact craft can become an elegant cohesive minimal line-icon and component system.
canvas: Landscape 3:2, high resolution. Flat front-facing digital design board with precise grid, generous breathing room, fine alignment. No perspective device mockups.
title: DreamFlutter · 器物化简
subtitle: 组件设计探索 · 第一稿

composition.top: A restrained title, then two equally wide columns. LEFT labeled「中国 · 文房与刻花」on warm paper #F7F3EB, dark ink #392F2A, warm cinnabar #A54C28. RIGHT labeled「海外 · 嵌木与玻璃」on deep charcoal #26221E with warm ivory #F0E5D6 and softened amber accent #E6A17A. One shared grid and consistent icon weights across both.
composition.source_strip: At the top of each column, a small beautifully drawn antique object line sketch transitioning through a 3-stroke geometric abstraction to a functional icon. Chinese examples: wind-shaped clay inkstone rim and a Song porcelain incised angular turn; international examples: Italian Renaissance inlaid wood corner and a delicate engraved glass vessel. Illustrative interpretations, not archaeological replicas. Only two or three motifs, no collage clutter.
composition.icons: The center is dominated by two matched sets of eight UI line icons, with short Chinese labels: 对话、记忆、日程、文件、搜索、设置、发送、停止. Same 24-unit drawing grid, approximately 1.6 stroke, balanced optical size, rounded joins. Show icons enlarged enough to scrutinize, with a small inset actual-size toolbar. All functions instantly recognizable. Cultural influence should be in line ending, measured corner rhythm and tiny rim cut, not in ornament pasted onto unrelated symbols. Search remains recognizable magnifier, close/stop remains conventional. No decorative circles around every icon.
composition.states: Below icons, a compact row of six real button specimens with tiny labels 默认、悬停、按下、已选、禁用、处理中. Use the same rounded rectangular button silhouette (9px radius equivalent), thin-line icon and text「继续」or「保存」. Different states distinct but restrained; focus ring only around focused specimen. Small down/press arrow or two-frame ghost indicates 1px press, do not invent giant animations.
composition.controls: Bottom row gives coherent toggle, three-option segmented control, pill filter, text field and one understated card header, each in the same theme. Option text 简洁、标准、详细. A small three-frame motion strip labeled「轻落 · 120ms」illustrates subtle press and release. Also one small selected sidebar row. Background carving is only a faint corner line motif at 4% opacity outside content.

typography: Clear accurate simplified Chinese. Elegant serif only for title/section labels, readable neutral Chinese sans for control labels. Minimal text, not paragraphs, no fictional specifications.
quality: Precise production-style UI design with individual character, refined proportions, vivid but restrained surfaces. Crisp slender vector-like ink paths, tiny fine paper texture. Component consistency is primary. Similar sophistication to a museum design system, not a fantasy game inventory or generic AI SaaS kit.
constraints: No butterfly logo or butterfly mascot: the real app's approved butterfly is intentionally not being redesigned. No halos, ornamental badges, unnecessary round frames, skeuomorphic gold bevels, gradients on every button, large shadows, glossy 3D, devices, people, ancient script, lorem ipsum, watermarks. Do not add decorative runes or unreadable microcopy. This is a new exploratory design, preserve recognizable everyday controls and consistent scale.
